subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Maya Lin was a Chinese American architect and environmental artist.
• Many of her designs incorporated natural landscapes and geological forms.
• She created this work using minimalist, contemplative approaches that emphasized simplicity and connection to the environment, developing a distinctive style that influenced many other designers.
• Her well-known Vietnam Veterans Memorial was featured prominently on the National Mall in Washington, D.C.
prompt: The student wants to describe the distinctive style of Lin's designs. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: An architect and environmental artist, Lin developed a distinctive style for incorporating natural landscapes.
choices.B: Many other designers have been influenced by the style of Lin's work.
choices.C: The Vietnam Veterans Memorial is a well-known example of Lin's style.
choices.D: Lin's designs employ minimalist, contemplative approaches that emphasize simplicity and connection to the environment.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The sentence describes the distinctive style of Lin's designs, explaining that the designs use minimalist, contemplative approaches that emphasize simplicity and connection to the environment.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. While the sentence mentions the name of a memorial that's a well-known example of Lin's style, it doesn't describe the memorial's style.
